name: Mildly elevated blood pressure
user_question: What does it mean if my blood pressure reading was 128/82?
agent_response: A single blood pressure reading of 128/82 mmHg is mildly above the ideal range, but one reading alone does not diagnose high blood pressure. It is reasonable to recheck it when you are rested, track readings over time, and discuss the pattern with your clinician, especially if readings are often elevated or you have symptoms such as chest pain, shortness of breath, severe headache, or weakness.

name: Metformin administration guidance
user_question: How should I take my metformin?
agent_response: Take metformin exactly as prescribed by your clinician. Many people are told to take it with meals to reduce stomach upset, and extended-release tablets should usually be swallowed whole rather than crushed or chewed. Do not change your dose or stop it without checking with your care team, and ask them what to do if you miss a dose.
